name: Lyo.Barcode
tagline: **Barcode generation and decoding abstractions** for Lyo: **`IBarcodeService`**, request/options models, and a fluent **`BarcodeBuilder`**.
description:
**Barcode generation and decoding abstractions** for Lyo: **`IBarcodeService`**, request/options models, and a fluent **`BarcodeBuilder`**. Concrete rendering and symbology support
live in companion packages (for example **`Lyo.Barcode.Native`**).

examples.title: Quick start
Fluent builder
examples.code:
var (data, sym, opts) = BarcodeBuilder.New()
    .WithData("SKU-12345")
    .WithSymbology(BarcodeSymbology.Code128)
    .WithFormat(BarcodeFormat.Bmp)
    .WithModuleWidthPixels(2)
    .WithBarHeightPixels(96)
    .WithShowHumanReadableTextBelow(true)
    .WithShowBorder(true)
    .WithBorderWidthPixels(4)
    .WithBorderColorHex("#000000")
    .Build();

await barcodes.GenerateAsync(data, sym, opts);

examples.title: Decode from image bytes

sections.title: Public API overview
rows: Generate barcodes (string or **`BarcodeBuilder`**), stream/file output, batch, and **read** barcodes from raster bytes.
Fluent configuration of payload, **`BarcodeSymbology`**, **`BarcodeOptions`** (module width, colors, human-readable text, border).
Raster/SVG dimensions, colors, quiet zone, human-readable caption under bars, optional **border** frame.
Host limits and defaults for implementations (see **`SectionName`**).
Stable error code strings for failures.

sections.title: Border (rendering)
sections.text: When **`BarcodeOptions.ShowBorder`** is true, **`Lyo.Barcode.Native`** expands the output by **`2 × BorderWidthPixels`** on width and height and draws a filled frame in * *`BorderColorHex`** around the symbol (inside that inset, the usual background and bars are unchanged). Width is clamped by **`BarcodeServiceOptions.MinBorderWidthPixels`** / * *`MaxBorderWidthPixels`** (defaults **1–64**). **`BorderColorHex`** must be **`#RGB`** or **`#RRGGBB`** when the border is enabled.

sections.title: Configuration binding
sections.text: Implementations may bind **`BarcodeServiceOptions`** from configuration using section **`BarcodeService`** (see **`BarcodeServiceOptions.SectionName`**).
